# Sajjad Ali

> Senior Software Developer at Badri Solutions in Karachi, Pakistan. Full-stack developer (Python, Node.js, React, Next.js) who turns actuarial models and formulas, supplied by actuaries, into production software for insurance and financial teams.

## Focus

- Actuarial and financial software: IFRS 17 cashflow and life models (GMM, VFA), end-of-service gratuity valuation (including IAS 19), insurance benchmarking, and medical claims auditing.
- Backend services and APIs with Python (FastAPI, Flask) and Node.js (Express, NestJS).
- Frontends and dashboards with React, Next.js, TypeScript, ApexCharts, and Plotly.
- Data processing with Pandas, Polars, and NumPy; desktop delivery with PySide, PyInstaller, PyWebview, and Electron.
- Previously: MERN stack developer at Solspro, and research fellow in machine learning at NTNU.

Client project code and data are confidential; project pages describe functionality and technology only.
